zoom_hint:
Ctrl+wheel or Ctrl +/- to zoom.
Layers can still be dragged while zoomed.
msg_unsupported_format_body:
Format '{ext}' not supported.
Use PNG, JPG, WEBP or BMP.
c_hint_free:
💡 Corner = moves on its own (slanted panels)
SHIFT+corner = resize keeping it rectangular
Drag inside = move • Ctrl+drag = crop
Make the panels TOUCH: the gap comes from 'Gap px',
always the same everywhere.
c_hint_cols:
💡 Drag an image in the preview to
move the crop.
c_hint_sig: 💡 Drag the signature in the preview to move it.
c_hint_frame:
💡 The collage is scaled down and centred inside
the frame opening. The final file has the
frame's size.
c_hint_civitai: 💡 Adds the Civitai search link under each hash.
c_empty: Add images to build the collage
s_language_hint:
To add a language: copy a file from Lang/,
rename it (e.g. fr.json) and translate the values.
s_links_hint:
For models NOT hosted on Civitai: write the name
(without extension) and the link where they live.
★ Wildcard: "ZipZap_OC_Ill_V*" covers every version.
If several wildcards match, the most specific wins, and an
exact name always beats a wildcard.
Models in this list never show the Civitai link.
s_metadata_hint:
These options are remembered on next launch.
⚠ With "Metadata" on, data is written inside the PNG
and the prompt .txt file is NOT created.
t_hint:
Drag the text on the canvas. Use + − ⟲ ⟳ for
size and rotation. Enter makes a new line.
t_hint_collage:
Drag the text in the preview.
Enter makes a new line.
p_hint:
Compose a text in the Editor or Collage with the color,
size and alignment you want, then press
"Save as preset": you'll find it in the Preset dropdown.
s_rng_hint:
RNG tells whether noise was generated on CPU or GPU:
it helps anyone trying to reproduce your generation.
